logline: A baby piglin catches a gold ingot that falls from the sky every six seconds and is saving all of them for a bastion of its own, grateful to the generous stranger up there who keeps giving it gifts, until we see the stranger's barter farm: the baby is stuck in the cell, and babies never barter.
question: why tf does gold fall on this baby piglin every six seconds?
premise: In the Nether by the Portal Cottage's portal, a player (efe skin) built a barter farm: a dropper drops one gold ingot every six seconds onto a one-piglin cell, the piglin barters, the hoppers carry the barters to a chest. A baby piglin chased an ingot down the farm's catch hole and landed in the cell. It thinks the cell is its room, the gold is a gift from a generous stranger, and it is saving up for a bastion of its own, for when it's big.
twist: The baby is the jam in the player's barter farm. Babies take gold and never barter (they keep it), so the farm has made nothing: every fix the player tried (a new hopper, a lava moat, a PLEASE WORK sign) the baby read as a present. The reveal is the picture: the farm's output chest open and empty under the hopper floor, the baby above it hugging an ingot as the dropper clicks out another. Fans' second layer: baby piglins never grow up, so 'for when I'm big' never comes.
payoff_note: `drop`: the stunt mark when the dropper fires the next ingot in S11, on 'SIX'; the Short ends <= 1.0 s after it (owner: cut right on the reveal). No line after L12.

world.place: portal_cottage_nether (new, claimed on this branch; the lead merges claims): the Nether side of the Portal Cottage's cellar portal, at about (-16, 80, -118) in Nether coordinates (the cellar portal (-126, 80, -938) / 8). A netherrack-and-basalt shelf over a lava lake; the portal Grandpa lit on day ~175; the player's barter farm about 10 blocks east of it; a bastion remnant across the lake.
world.canon: Not Buh's story and nobody from the Portal Cottage appears. The player is a new, nameless player (efe skin, conflict 18). The piglins crowd this shelf because a gold ingot comes out of the portal every night (Grandma's, Gold for the Portal): that is why the player built his farm here. Never said. The baby never grows up (vanilla), so it can still be here on day 9300 for any later story.

lines.text: Every SIX seconds, / a gold INGOT / falls from the SKY. / I've caught / FOUR HUNDRED.

lines.direction: proud and amazed, one quick breath; the number lands

lines.text: I found / this ROOM / chasing one / down a HOLE.

lines.direction: delighted, like finding a secret clubhouse

lines.text: It has a WINDOW, / so I can watch / the GROWN-UPS.
lines.say: It has a window, so I can watch the GROWN-UPS.

lines.text: They give their gold / AWAY / for GRAVEL. / FOOLS.
lines.say: They give their gold away for gravel. FOOLS.
lines.direction: a tiny scoff, very superior, then a giggle

lines.text: Not ME. / I'm saving up / for a whole BASTION. / For when I'm BIG.
lines.say: Not me. I'm saving up for a whole bastion. For when I'm BIG.

lines.text: And somebody / up there / is very / GENEROUS.

lines.text: He gave me / a shiny / new FLOOR.
lines.say: He gave me a shiny new FLOOR.

lines.text: A MOAT / of LAVA, / like a real / CASTLE.

fed up, flat, staring into a box

lines.say: He loves gravel. Grown-ups are SO weird.

lines.text: So I hug my GOLD, / and I count / to SIX.
lines.say: So I hug my gold, and I count to SIX.
